files.data/hours.yml:
# Opening hours. Drives the page, the footer, the "open now" pill and the
# structured data; later also the Google Business Profile.
# Source: the bar's Google Maps entry, read 15 Nov 2026 (the old website only said
# "until late"). Days: mo tu we th fr sa su. Times are Zurich wall clock, 24 h.
# A close time at or before the open time means "after midnight" (02:00 = 2 am the
# next morning). close: null means "until late".
regular:
  - days: [mo, tu, we, th]
    open: "16:00"
    close: "00:00"
  - days: [fr]
    open: "16:00"
    close: "02:00"
  - days: [sa]
    open: "10:00"
    close: "02:00"
  - days: [su]
    open: "10:00"
    close: "00:00"
# Dated exceptions, for example:
#   - date: 2026-12-25
#     closed: true
#   - date: 2026-12-31
#     open: "18:00"
#     close: "03:00"
exceptions: []
